en.name: Barbell Curl
en.about: A standing arm exercise: you curl a barbell from your thighs to your shoulders, bending only at the elbows. It builds the biceps.
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell with your palms facing forward and your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Let the bar hang at your thighs with your wrists, elbows and shoulders in line.
Keeping your elbows at your sides, bend them to curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Keep your chest and upper body still, so that only your forearms move.
Lower the bar slowly and under control until your arms are straight again.

mistakes.says: Body swings to lift the bar. Keep your chest still and lift with your arms alone.
Elbows drift forward or out. Keep them close to your sides through the whole rep.
Bar drops quickly. Lower it slowly and under control.
